caption: A single uncut full-body shot on a concrete plaza. The same young skateboarder faces the camera and begins a slow relaxed pivot. He has shoulder-length curly dark hair, tan skin, a narrow face, and a relaxed smile. He wears a faded red hoodie with a small white star patch on the left sleeve, loose black cargo pants, white high-top sneakers, and holds a teal skateboard with orange wheels under his right arm. Smooth continuous motion, no scene cut, late afternoon sunlight, urban plaza background.
